neighbours.label: the first piece of a split verb or rare word (' escri'|bir, ' impe'|ach, m|ose|y, cu|atri|partita) (guess)
fire: Todos son libres de escribir lo que quieran.
Congress voted to impeach the governor last year.
He likes to mosey down to the river after lunch.
La bóveda cuatripartita es de estilo gótico.
Los niños aprenden a escribir en la escuela.
They could impeach the judge for that ruling.
We moseyed along the path until sunset.
Una planta cuatripartita cubre la iglesia.
quiet: Todos son libres de comer lo que quieran.
Congress voted to thank the governor last year.
He likes to walk down to the river after lunch.
La iglesia grande es de estilo gótico.
Los niños aprenden a nadar en la escuela.
They could call the judge for that ruling.
We walked along the path until sunset.
Una planta alta cubre la iglesia.
